description: Search PepBank study findings across all peptides by topic, outcome or question. Each result gives the finding in plain words, the peptide, the evidence class and its source passages. The response also gives the PepBank credit line to show. Use it for questions like "which peptides were studied for tendon healing". Use peptide_research when the user names one peptide.

cursor.description: The next_cursor value from the previous result, to get the next page.

query.description: Search words, for example tendon healing or BPC-157 inflammation.
